timingAuthority: Original source records and parent completion/caveat disclosures only; no inferred deadline compliance.

qa.static: Frozen original and runtime source mapping hashes checked.
qa.visual: Genuine nonblank default view captured; contact sheet reviewed. No visual score.
qa.interactive: Original start control and bounded W/R input dispatch without errors; iframe/context unload verified. No full-route claim.
qa.gpu: Browser rendering observed; no GPU benchmark or compatibility guarantee.

generationSeparation: No entrant coaching, edits, repairs, rebuilds or post-deadline fixes. Active entrants never inspected.
releaseGate: Local validation passed. Public host/service parity and production responses require publication readback.
